company_description: Jacobs Solutions Inc. engages in the infrastructure and advanced facilities, and consulting businesses in the United States, Europe, Canada, India, Asia, Australia, New Zealand, the Middle East, and Africa. The company provides consulting, planning, architecture, design, engineering, and infrastructure delivery services including project, program, and construction management and long-term operation of facilities. It also offers consulting services for consumer and manufacturing, defense and security, energy and utilities, financial services, government, health and life sciences, and transport sectors. The company was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Dallas, Texas.

risks.title: Acquisition Integration Risks
risks.summary: Acquisitions and strategic investments carry integration risks, hidden costs and exposure to new business segments.
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to significant risks related to integrating acquired businesses. The report explicitly mentions potential integration difficulties, associated costs and limitations of indemnification rights. These risks could negatively impact operating results.

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance Risks
risks.summary: Exposure to environmental, safety and other regulations that could result in penalties and significant operational impacts.
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in areas subject to strict environmental, safety and other regulations. Non-compliance can result in severe penalties and a material impact on operations.

risks.title: Accounting Estimates and Judgments Risks
risks.summary: Long-term engineering and construction contracts require complex cost estimates that may affect reported results.
risks.score_rationale: Revenue recognition on long-term contracts and future cost estimates require significant judgments. Estimation errors could materially affect financial results.

risks.title: Pension Risks and Actuarial Assumptions
risks.summary: Pension liabilities are sensitive to changes in discount rates and expected returns, with potentially significant balance sheet impacts.
risks.score_rationale: Pension plans carry significant risks related to actuarial assumptions (discount rates, expected returns). Even modest changes (1%) could impact liabilities by $139 million.

risks.title: Litigation and Insurance Risks
risks.summary: Exposure to liability claims and personal injury with only partial insurance coverage.
risks.score_rationale: The company faces litigation risks (professional liability, personal injury claims) and chooses to self-insure a portion of losses. Insurers may not honor all claims.

risks.title: Redeemable Non-Controlling Interests Risks
risks.summary: Redeemable non-controlling interests in PA Consulting introduce accounting complexity and potential volatility tied to valuations based on future performance.
risks.score_rationale: The PA Consulting investment creates a complex fair value obligation based on projected future revenues and EBITDA. Holders have put options based on fair value, creating potential volatility.
